name: Imola (San Marino GP)
summary: Ferrari country: an anticlockwise circuit named after Enzo and Dino Ferrari.
character: Old-school: narrow and fast, with gravel close to the track and little room to pass. After 1994 chicanes slowed the fastest corners.

layouts.name: Post-1994 layout
factNotes: One layout from 1995 to 2006. Races dropped from 63 to 62 laps in 1997 because the grid moved, not the track.

moments.title: Alonso holds off Schumacher
moments.body: In 2005 Fernando Alonso kept a much faster Michael Schumacher behind him for the closing laps to win.

history.body: Hosted the Italian Grand Prix while Monza was being upgraded.
Home of the San Marino Grand Prix.
Roland Ratzenberger and Ayrton Senna were killed in the same weekend. Chicanes followed in 1995.
Back as the Emilia Romagna Grand Prix. The 2023 race was cancelled after floods.

leftCalendar: The San Marino GP was dropped after 2006. Imola came back for 2020-2025 and then left the calendar again from 2026.
